## Family Stories

Walter — known as Uncle Watt in the family — was a son of John and Caroline Telfer. He features in the story of his brother Ernest's birth, remarking that Ernie was "a larrikin." He appears in the family photo from about 1911 at Angle Farm. He was a witness to the pioneer years on Willow Plains and Warcowie. He married twice — first to Stella Vickery and later to Dorothy Richie — and raised a family. *(From the Borders to the Bush, pp.118, 122, 141, 179)*
